report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: checkout traces show all 200/ok across order, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order; order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200s and zero 502s on v1.0.0, with v2.0.0 receiving no traffic. The deployment record only shows baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No current evidence substantiates a bounded root cause; logs were excluded.
